issues.what: A close, soft, snow-covered rock wall framing one broad blade of a mountain is replaced by an unobstructed view of two similarly sharp, narrow horns on separate mounds; the main mountain no longer fills the near middle ground.
issues.fix: Bring a near rock wall into the left foreground and give the struck peak a broader, steep, continuous face with a snow shelf and descending right flank.

issues.where: right background and below the ridges
issues.what: Repeated bright, similarly shaped horns on clear ridges read close together rather than successive dark peaks receding through a deep cloud sea; there is little blowing snow even beside the main peak.
issues.fix: Stagger the silhouettes at greater apparent distances, use progressively softer contrast, bank moving fog around their bases, and add diagonal drift across the near face.

issues.what: Hard-edged, stretched gray cloud bands and an even peach horizon replace turbulent violet-lit cloud volumes and a narrow, broken, brighter orange gap toward the right.
issues.fix: Build layered, softly lit storm clouds with localized violet light and confine the sunset to thin irregular openings low on the right.

issues.what: Two large nearly white bolts, one across the middle of the image, dominate the shot; the main impact floats just off the tip and does not light up the rock or a dense plume around it as in the target.
issues.fix: Concentrate attention on one violet-white strike that meets the tip, with thinner branches, lit vapor, warm sparks and violet light falling off down the adjacent rock.

issues.what: Exposed rock is broadly pale and tan and the snow reads as broad smooth blankets, losing the dark blue-gray fractured faces and patchy wind-packed snow of the target.
issues.fix: Keep the faces in cool shadow away from the strike, use irregular stratified slabs, and collect snow more selectively on ledges and in gullies.

issues.what: The view opens onto a level dark expanse with thin horns and a smooth horizon, rather than a nearby sloping snow basin, scattered rocks and a large sharp ridge rising behind it.
issues.fix: Build the snow approach rising out of the mouth, with uneven drifts, exposed rocks and a trail into a broad rocky blade beyond.

issues.where: ceiling, left wall and lip of the cave
issues.what: A smooth oval tunnel with continuous warm puckered texture replaces layered rock slabs, clear ice running down the walls, and an irregular lip fringed with hanging icicles.
issues.fix: Break up the profile and rock into broad angular layers, put clear ice and cool reflections on the walls, and hang varied icicles along the exposed rim.

issues.what: A uniform dark rippled surface with repeated orange ring highlights replaces irregular pale glossy ice broken by snowbanks, small chunks and a prominent right-hand rock.
issues.fix: Use uneven translucent ice with subdued cool reflections from the mouth, wind-packed snow along the margins, and embedded stones and broken ice for scale.

issues.where: animal group and near left foreground
issues.what: The standing animal sits farther right and lower and lacks the bright backlit silhouette at the threshold; the group reads as a few low, overlapping forms crowded into the near left, losing the deeper staggered cluster with separate raised heads and the soft foreground occlusion.
issues.fix: Move the standing animal toward the left side of the mouth and light it from outside, stagger the resting forms farther back along the wall, and restore a soft near-left foreground layer.

issues.where: air and sky beyond the cave mouth
issues.what: A sharply visible branching bolt and angular gray cloud bands take the place of the purple glow behind cloud, visibly windblown snow across the approach, and a broken orange strip at the horizon.
issues.fix: Diffuse the flash within the clouds, add crosswind snow and low drift that veil the middle distance, and break the orange light into narrow horizon gaps.

issues.where: streamers and lines strung from the pinnacles
issues.what: The streamers appear as opaque, pale, outlined tangles repeated on multiple peaks rather than fine dark lines carrying thin translucent lilac sheets with intermittent electrical glints.
issues.fix: Make the fabric thinner and more transparent with restrained lilac edge light, separate the fine support lines, and reduce the prominence of streamers on far peaks.

issues.where: shag on the standing and resting animals
issues.what: The coats are uniformly dark, dry and finely brushed, losing the clumped wet strands, pale surface frost and stray fibers that catch cool light in the target.
issues.fix: Add irregular frost buildup on upward-facing coats, group the strands into weighted clumps, and retain pale violet rim highlights on the strands facing the entrance.

issues.where: struck horn face and spark field below the strike
issues.what: At delivery size the horn has repeated dark rectangular steps across its face, and particles show a regular dotted pattern in the sky.
issues.fix: Remove the hard repeated steps and scatter the particles more naturally in depth and density.
